item.title: Huge crowds gather at final pre-election rally of Serbia's students
item.description: Hundreds of thousands of supporters of Serbia’s protesting students have gathered for the final campaign rally ahead of the tense parliamentary election on weekend in a mounting challenge to the Balkan country’s powerful strongman Aleksandar Vucic.

item.title: Gunfire and chaotic scenes in Kenyan border town as hundreds flee Ethiopia
item.description: A police officer and a 31-year-old woman were hit by stray bullets in the northern Kenyan border town of Moyale as hundreds of Ethiopians fled into Kenya, police said.
